public.text: Store-and-forward and publish-subscribe are presented as supporting intermittent connectivity. These patterns require durable messaging, local queues, identity continuity, duplicate handling, reconciliation, and conflict management, which are not described.
public.suggestedRevision: Add minimum requirements for message persistence, delivery status, retry, deduplication, ordering where required, expiry, reconciliation, conflict resolution, security, and monitoring.
